entities.name: A0L486 RNA polymerase omega
observations: The query is an exact 121-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt A0L486 from Magnetococcus marinus.
RNA polymerase subunit omega promotes assembly by latching the N- and C-terminal regions of beta-prime and facilitating beta/beta-prime/alpha interactions.
The query contains the RNA_pol_Rpb6 Pfam domain (PF01192.28), residues 8–58; i-Evalue 3e-20.
The returned annotation associates this protein with DNA-templated transcription; localization was not explicitly returned.

entities.name: DNA-templated transcription
observations: UniProt-associated GO annotation: GO:0006351, DNA-templated transcription (evidence ECO:0000501).

entities.name: RNA polymerase core
observations: The curated reference annotation describes the catalytic core as two alpha, one beta, one beta-prime, and one omega subunit; sigma association forms the holoenzyme.
